pack: Zelda: Remastered 1.3 — The Legend of Zelda (USA)

known_missing.reason: Dead entry, verified against the shipped assets. selectscreen1..6.png are 512x480, 100% opaque and differ from one another by ~0.1% of their pixels: six frames of one full-screen image, driven at priority 1 by <condition>ZeldaSelectScreenframeN,frameRange,60,{50,40,30,20,10,0}, which covers the whole 60-frame cycle so one is always active. selectscreentop.png (12.4% opaque) draws over them at priority 39. A priority-10 full-screen layer between the two would cancel the animation, so this line reads as a leftover from a pre-animation build. HdPackLoader::ProcessBackgroundTag drops the entry at load, making the rendered screen identical with or without it.
